findings.item: Listening shared script and ielts-meta-wave-2-band-6-listening-01 through -05
findings.issue: The embedded normalizationFindings already flags the script at 402 words against a 300–400 target. Counting the full script yields 403 whitespace-delimited tokens (and 403 words with a standard word-token count), so the concern remains. Trim the script to at most 400 words and update its wordCount/normalizationFindings before approval.
The phrase ‘about five minutes walk away’ is unnatural English; revise to ‘about a five-minute walk away’ or ‘about five minutes’ walk away.’
